name: My Summer
source:
Due to my low score, I have to go to school this Summer. It's not so bad for me though. I have a girlfriend, and I earn a lot of money from trading cryptocurrencies. Nothing can turn my life upside down, right?​

[From F95Zone]
translation:
由于我的分数低，今年夏天我必须去上学。不过这对我来说还不错。我有一个女朋友，我通过交易加密货币赚了很多钱。没有什么可以让我的生活发生翻天覆地的变化，对吗？​

[来自F95Zone]
